newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Keppel Philippines, Kepphil Shipyard set stock div.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Philippines, Kepphil Shipyard set stock div.

text.p: Keppel Philippines Holdings Inc said on Tuesday its board had approved payment of a 15 percent stock dividend.
In a separate advisory, Kepphil Shipyard Inc announced an eight percent stock dividend.
The dividends are yet to be approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission, the companies told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The dividends will be to comply with the subscription of their new capital structures.
Keppel, an investment firm, is increasing its capital stock to 665 million pesos from 480 million, while its shipbuilding unit Kepphil is raising its stock to 1.93 billion pesos from 1.68 billion.
